concept: Using professional or civic influence to support environmental responsibility, where the adult has real leverage
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic professional or civic scenario where the adult has some genuine influence over a decision with environmental impact (a business practice, a local policy, a workplace policy)
exercise.reflection_prompt: Where do you actually have real leverage here, versus just an opinion?
exercise.practice: Adult identifies one specific point of real leverage and how they'd use it

assessment.success_marker: adult identifies genuine leverage they hold, not just a wish that someone else would act
